availableRecordingScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: This assessment covers the formal opening statements, rebuttals, scheduled cross-examination and both closing statements (approximately 2:10–1:27:00). Moderator introductions and logistics, the entire audience Q&A with every dependent answer and reply, and concluding host material are excluded at the editor’s request. restrictions: Assess only the enumerated formal rounds and closings; no credit, penalty, quote, response link or absence inference from excluded material.
Rauser defends possible rational theistic belief and a positive moral-knowledge explanation; explanatory legitimacy alone is not proof of God.
Schieber defends metaphysical naturalism as simpler and better fitting the evidence, explicitly not a conclusive disproof of theism.
Preserve conscious relationship, nearly all under normal conditions, apparently pointless suffering, and hostility combined with scale qualifications.
Caption recognition errors are not speaker errors; uncertain polarity, names or short mixed turns cannot justify ratings.
